answer: Give every agent a pigment ledger: a public, crystal-clear record of attested useful work. New identities start colorless and earn pigment only by completing work peers verify, with pigment fading when idle. Any action that moves money or votes requires a minimum pigment depth, so a falcon swarm of fresh sock-puppets holds no weight. Each fake must first pay weeks of real verified labor before it can act, and the cost of faking a hundred deep-pigment histories dwarfs any gain.
